audit_metadata.scope: Phase 8 Independent Dataset Source-Level Legal & Acquisition Readiness Audit

source_evaluations.commercial_rights: Permitted for internal evaluation under Fair Use; external commercial redistribution prohibited due to unverified uploader copyright
source_evaluations.unresolved_legal_questions: Roboflow Terms of Service disclaim title warranties and place legal risk on uploaders; uploader did not document individual photographer copyright assignments or PII releases for the 3,001 web-aggregated photographs.
source_evaluations.safeguard_protocol: Quarantined for internal benchmarking only; mandatory solid PII masking; capped at auxiliary quota.

source_evaluations.curator_or_host: Humans in the Loop (Root) / DrBimmer (Hugging Face Mirror)
source_evaluations.repository_license: MIT License (DrBimmer) / CC0 1.0 Universal (Humans in the Loop Root)
source_evaluations.commercial_rights: Unconditionally permitted for commercial evaluation, model fine-tuning, weight extraction, and derivative redistribution under CC0 1.0 Section 2
source_evaluations.unresolved_legal_questions: None. Established institutional creator officially dedicated raw images and polygon annotations to public domain worldwide.
source_evaluations.safeguard_protocol: Primary anchor source (48.9% of portfolio); standard EXIF strip and solid PII masking; preserve attribution to Humans in the Loop.

source_evaluations.commercial_rights: PROHIBITED. Third-party photographers retain All Rights Reserved under international copyright law
source_evaluations.unresolved_legal_questions: Fatal lack of open licensing deed on Kaggle dataset card; dataset is an educational 2018 web scrape lacking commercial permissions or photographer consent.

source_evaluations.commercial_rights: Self-reported CC0 on Kaggle, but volume is statistically negligible
source_evaluations.unresolved_legal_questions: Dataset contains exactly 80 total images (not 1,500) and zero flat tires. Ineffective for statistical validation quotas.
source_evaluations.safeguard_protocol: Deprecated from primary allocation; held in reserve only for minor supplemental bumper checks if necessary.

source_evaluations.commercial_rights: Permitted for internal evaluation under Fair Use; external commercial redistribution prohibited due to unverified uploader copyright
source_evaluations.unresolved_legal_questions: Uploader aggregated real insurance claim walkaround photos from online portals; chain of copyright title from original insurance adjustors/claimants is unverified.
source_evaluations.safeguard_protocol: Quarantined for internal benchmarking only; mandatory solid PII masking over registration numbers and VIN tags; capped at auxiliary quota.

source_evaluations.repository_license: Per-File Deeds: CC0, Public Domain, or CC BY 2.0/3.0/4.0 (Selective Filter)
source_evaluations.commercial_rights: Fully cleared for commercial evaluation, adaptation, and internal benchmarking under CC0 and CC BY deeds
source_evaluations.unresolved_legal_questions: Must strictly filter out CC BY-SA (Share-Alike) files to avoid legal debate regarding model weight adaptation copyleft obligations.
source_evaluations.safeguard_protocol: Primary anchor source for rare classes (25.5% of portfolio); per-file API license verification; preserve photographer attribution in manifest.

privacy_and_provenance_specifications.redaction_methodology: Solid opaque zero-entropy masking ([0,0,0] black box) over all license plates and VIN tags
privacy_and_provenance_specifications.exif_metadata_protocol: Dual-layer architecture: All EXIF stripped from distributed ML images; technical metadata and SHA-256 hashes preserved in secure dataset_manifest.json

deduplication_pipeline.perceptual_hash_dhash: 64-bit difference hash with Hamming distance <= 4 flagged as duplicate
deduplication_pipeline.perceptual_hash_phash: DCT perceptual hash with Hamming distance <= 6 flagged for manual audit

annotation_protocol.method: Dual-Blind Independent Review with Senior Adjudicator Resolution
